reel.title: Year 4 trip to the Science Museum

scenes.title: Museum trip
scenes.caption: Year 4 visits the Science Museum on 11 December.
scenes.say: Oakfield Primary's Year 4 are off to the Science Museum, on Friday the eleventh of December. Here's what parents need to know.

scenes.title: The day
scenes.caption: Be in class by 8.30. Back about 3.45.
scenes.say: Children must be in their classroom by half past eight, as the coach leaves at 8.45 sharp. Collect them from the main hall about 3.45.

scenes.title: The cost
scenes.caption: The trip costs £14.50 a child.
scenes.say: The trip costs fourteen pounds fifty a child, covering the coach and the workshop. Pay on ParentPay by Friday the twenty-seventh of November.

scenes.title: Free meals
scenes.caption: Free school meals means a free trip and packed lunch.
scenes.say: If you get free school meals, the trip is free, and the school will give your child a packed lunch.

scenes.title: What to bring
scenes.caption: Packed lunch, coat and uniform. No money, phones or toys.
scenes.say: Pack a lunch with no glass bottles or nuts, a waterproof coat, and school uniform. Please leave money, phones and toys at home.

scenes.title: Helpers and medicine
scenes.caption: Four helpers needed. Medicine must be in school, labelled.
scenes.say: They need four parent helpers with a DBS check at the school. Tell the class teacher by the twenty-seventh. Medicine should be in school, labelled with a name.

scenes.title: Consent slip
scenes.caption: No consent slip on ParentPay, no trip.
scenes.say: One last thing. Fill in the consent slip on ParentPay. Without it, your child cannot go on the trip.
